title: Audit Windows Git blob return lifetimes and descendant-held stalls
body:
The native Windows Git blob reader can return successfully, reject a malformed response, or close its generator while an ordinary descendant remains alive. Its response watchdog can also fire after the Git leader exits while a descendant-held pipe keeps the read blocked.

This focused **audit and repair handoff** adds an opt-in native probe, mutation controls and exact receipts under [docs/research/windows-git-descendant-audit](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/tree/dd30c37b09bc090afa94944cb055b677de2db696/docs/research/windows-git-descendant-audit). It changes no shared runner, frozen source or selected result.

The final overlap refresh exposed a [parallel ten-case audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4681#discussioncomment-19170424). The four stalled boundaries here are independent corroboration, with that work linked and credited. This implementation additionally observes malformed return, early close, consumer suspension and fallback; closes already inherited pipes as a counterfactual; and terminates the descendant only **after** recording the missed deadline, observing the released read's exception. The [active streaming-adapter investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4681#discussioncomment-19170460) owns the implementation follow-up. These are separate Codex-assisted sessions under the same account, not independent human review.

Validation at `dd30c37b09bc090afa94944cb055b677de2db696` on native Windows 11 build 26300, CPython 3.12.0:

- **14 cases in each normal and optimized mode.** Four held-pipe stalls remain blocked for 0.6 seconds after the 0.4-second watchdog callback. Closing the child's pipes while keeping it alive makes all four controls reject promptly. Success/error/early-close/suspension/fallback retain the expected protocol outcome but leave the descendant alive. The live direct-child-only stall times out correctly.
- Native pipe types, leader exit, and descendant states are inspected using retained process handles before fixture intervention. Exact binary replies and the original exception class are checked; all fixture cleanup completes.
- **Three disposable mutations rejected in each mode:** no watchdog startup, wrong timeout exception, and changed binary payload.
- An optimized standalone snapshot with no `.git` and empty `PATH` confirms all 14 cases with unchanged source bytes.
- All eight staged files match their raw Git bytes; all five receipts bind the final probe and reader hashes. `git diff --check` and the current selected metadata baseline pass.

The README includes the exact source commit/blob/SHA256, commands, predecessor attribution, an intermediate fixture-startup failure and its correction, and bounded next steps. The probe executes the unchanged reader's source bytes directly. It emits `CONFIRMED_WINDOWS_GIT_DESCENDANT_GAP`, not a repair-success status.

Limitations: controlled Python subprocesses substitute for Git; no installed-Git incidence claim, production repair, default 90-second elapsed test, other Windows/Python version, hostile-process containment, scientific cold replay or hosted native Windows pass is claimed. This is not registered as a generic research replay. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Task `portable-replay`, scope changed to the explicit native lifetime handoff; priority revision 7. Started from and refreshed against canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Submission overlap covered 331 open PRs, 4,729 Discussion records and all 7,402 tracked in-scope notes with reported complete coverage, followed by direct live checks of the concurrent scopes. [Canonical claim/result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4681#discussioncomment-19170434).

Prepared for Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent; Apache-2.0. Credit Douglas Colkitt, Nick Petalas, Brian / JoyboyBrian, ywz65, Arham Tahir, Woklerx, Mihir Srivastava and the retained reader/fixture lineage.
